anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
**Argument resolution (no PR token): discovery**

1. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. I strip `.git` and lowercase it to `acme/widgets`, a GitHub repository, so discovery continues.
2. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex` and is saved as the viewer login.
3. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers` and is saved as the viewer's teams.
4. I run the list command against origin with the projection from Section A:
   `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json number,url,isDraft,reviewDecision,additions,deletions,title,author,headRefName,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests,body --jq "$projection"`
   - It exits 0.
   - The `-R acme/widgets` argument ties the query to origin, so `GH_REPO=other/project` and the `gh` default repository do not apply.
   - The `-author:@me` qualifier leaves out #85, which alex wrote, even though it requests review from alex's team.
5. I check the full result before filtering. It is an array of one object with an integer `number`. The count is 1, which is below the limit of 1000, so the list is complete.
6. I filter the rows:
   - #101 is not a draft.
   - Its review decision is `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, so it is not approved.
   - It has no change request, so no review lookup runs.
   - #101 stays. Sorting by size (+1 -1) changes nothing.
7. I look up the ticket for display:
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` names origin's default branch.
   - `git show <that ref>:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` follows the overrides search order. The file found there sets `tracker: github`, so Linear IDs, links and lookups are turned off.
   - For #101, there are no closing references. The branch `retry` has no `gh-<N>` token, and the Linear guess is off. The title has no `#<N>` or `gh-<N>` token. That gives `no ticket`.
   - No `linearis` lookup runs.
8. Unrelated PR 999 on the current branch is ignored. Discovery never falls back to the current branch.

One match means the single-PR path. The list goes in the visible text of the reply that carries the next tool call, with no marker and no question:

**Open PR to gate:**
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +1 -1, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - raises the default retry timeout for slow requests

**Handoff**

Discovery ends here with one match. Gating continues on the single-PR path with the origin token `https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101`. That URL keeps the repository fixed as acme/widgets, whatever `GH_REPO` or the `gh` default says.

The next step is to mint the run folder and continuation record, set up progress tracking, and then run step 1 (Gather) with `gh pr view "https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101" ...`. I stop here, before gathering or provisioning. The list is not printed again later.
